summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.21/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.21 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 29, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 14¢ lower than a week ago, 43¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.45 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.02) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.36).
